lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canadian negotiators dispel idea Canada can just play for time in trade talks with Trump, The Canadian Press reports.
At China summit, Trump calls Putin ‘my friend’ amid Ukraine war, ABC News reports.
Only hours after the release of “Grand Theft Auto VI,” Sera Tulk sat in a University of Toronto lecture hall, playing the year’s most hotly anticipated video game, The Canadian Press reports.
The Trump administration on Thursday moved to effectively drop its lawsuit that sought to block the certification of Democrat Mary Peltola’s victory in Alaska’s U.S, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
